department: Faculty of Medicine (UKE), PhD programme for non-medical students

deadline.value: You can apply for admission on an ongoing basis, but check the committee's submission deadlines on the website.
deadline.quote: You can apply for admission on an ongoing basis.

also.quote: Please note the deadlines for submitting applications to the doctoral committee on the website.

gre_subject.value: The programme's admission pages do not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: You need a supervision agreement with a Faculty of Medicine professor or habilitated member before applying.
supervisor.quote: Confirmation of a supervisor (supervision agreement), who must generally be a university lecturer (Prof.) or habilitated member (PD) of the Faculty of Medicine

funding.value: The programme itself offers no funding; applicants must find their own scholarship, fellowship or research-project job.
funding.quote: The PhD program itself does not offer financial support or funded PhD positions.

entry_route.value: A master's degree of at least 300 ECTS credits is required, in biosciences, psychology or public health.
entry_route.quote: a master’s degree program encompassing a total of at least 300 ECTS credits including the previously completed undergraduate program

notes: A separate school with its own doctoral committee and application (Docata). The page states no fee, GRE or English rule, so the university record applies. Prerequisites are biosciences, psychology or public-health degrees.
name: PhD programme for non-medical students
